title: Balls in a spinning hexagon
summary: Twenty numbered balls under gravity inside a hexagon that turns once every ten seconds. Physics written from scratch: moving-wall collisions, ball-to-ball contact, friction and visible spin. No libraries.
watchFor: Do any balls tunnel through a wall or escape?
Does the rotating wall push the balls in a believable way?
Do the numbers spin with the balls?
Does the pile settle, jitter or sink into itself?
interaction: No input: the first 20 seconds after page load, recorded frame by frame.
